June (Finance): Quick alert 188250246811: batch run batch_20260502_20 produced some strange invoice fragments. A couple customers show two invoices where one contains only 'experiment_rate' lines and the other contains all standard usage.

Arun (Billing Eng): Which batch + sample invoice id? Ill grep the generator logs.

June (Finance): batch_20260502_20. Sample acct: Northwave (acct_id=82490). We have INV-82490-20260502 and INV-82490-20260502-partial. The partial has only lines labeled rate=experiment_rate_v2, no reserved credits or standard usage. Totals don't add up.

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.19 job job_20260502_20_6 WARNING created_provisional_invoice acct=82490 reason=rate_namespace_mismatch

Arun (Billing Eng): rate_namespace_mismatch — interesting. We shipped a change last night that namespaces rate keys for experiments. It looks like the experiment rows were written with a different namespace and the aggregator treated them as a separate invoice fragment.

Marta (RevOps): Support already has a ticket. Customer worried about duplicate-looking invoices. We should consolidate and issue a credit memo for the fragment. Also recommend adding a pre-issue check for rate_namespace_mismatch.

Eli (Acct Mgr): Finance, do we need explicit sign-off to void the provisional invoice and reissue consolidated one? Customer-facing note will help.

June (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for this acct and any others in the batch. Net impact expected 0. Please attach recon CSV and include "reissued due to internal billing fragmentation" on the invoice memo.

Arun (Billing Eng): Plan: scan batch_20260502_20 for reason=rate_namespace_mismatch, dry-run regen with namespace normalization, then apply: create CM for provisional invoices and emit reissued invoices flagged as "reissued due to internal billing fragmentation". Command: `billing_tool --batch batch_20260502_20 --normalize-rate-namespace --dry-run`

BillingBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-9120 (investigate rate_namespace_mismatch + pre-issue guard)

Arun (Billing Eng): Running dry-run. Quick results: 4 accounts affected including 82490. Dry-run payloads look good. Holding apply until recon CSV and finance ack for all 4.

Marta (RevOps): Ill draft the customer note; short apology and confirmation of net-zero impact.

June (Finance): Ack. Approve apply for those 4 accounts. Arun, please upload reconciliation and the list of affected accounts here when done.

Arun (Billing Eng): Applying fixes now. Created credit memos for provisional fragments and reissued consolidated invoices. Uploaded recon: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-05-02/batch_20260502_20_recon_1882502468.csv

Eli (Acct Mgr): Customer notified and appreciates the proactive note. Closing loop once BIL-9120 has the postmortem and a test to prevent namespace drift.

BillingBot: [system] reconciliation_report uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-05-02/batch_20260502_20_recon_1882502468.csv"
